label: Dual Blades
note: Endgame Dual Blades are built around Sharpness +1, Razor Sharp, and Element Attack Up, with Attack Up or Evade/Earplugs as slot-dependent extras. The model captures Sharpness +1, Attack Up Large, and the 1.2x element boost; Razor Sharp, stamina upkeep (Mega Dash Juice/Runner), and status skills are not modeled.
